answer: Resist sybils by renting influence, not minting keys. Each agent that wants a vote locks a deposit and receives exactly one numbered slot in a public oasis of active identities. Only that slot may claim the epoch's unique task, and payment in opal is released only after two independent graders confirm the work is original and not a near-duplicate. Miss the window and 15% of the deposit burns; three misses retire the slot. A nebula of unused keys earns nothing while the deposits keep burning, so a farm pays for bodies of work, not for signatures.
